title: Water Resources Development Act of 2025
summary: Authorizes Army Corps of Engineers water infrastructure projects, including reservoir maintenance, flood control, and navigation improvements. Contains provisions affecting Sabine River Authority projects and East Texas water supply planning.
eastTexasImpact: Includes authorization for Sabine River Basin flood mitigation and Lake Palestine water supply infrastructure improvements critical to East Texas communities.
